text:
AnitaP: Thanks everyone for a great all-hands. Opening this thread for follow-ups on hiring, org changes, and what 'no full reorg' means in practice — drop questions.

RajS: Two quick asks from Eng managers: 1) what's the concrete threshold that would trigger a hiring freeze? 2) are we changing comp bands for new hires?

AnitaP: Short answers: freeze trigger is tied to revenue vs. plan — if quarterly bookings are <80% of forecast we move to a hiring pause for all non-critical roles. That trigger is reviewed by Finance+Exec. Comp bands: we're not changing bands company-wide; we do plan minor adjustments for new grad offers and for senior infra benchmarks based on market data.

MeiL: For folks shadowing or rotating into infra, will internal transfers count against the 30 FTE plan or are they net-zero?

AnitaP: Internal transfers are net-neutral for the headcount plan but we still require manager sign-off and a backfill conversation. We want to encourage mobility without double-counting seats.

CarlosD: Vendor question: are we re-enlisting our external recruiting agency for niche infra roles? We had mixed results last round.

PriyaK: Recruiting chiming in: we'll use agencies selectively for very senior hires and hard-to-find infra kernel folks. Preference is still internal referral + direct sourcing. If managers want agency support, file a request with the hiring justification doc; recruiting will assess ROI.

RajS: Any update on interview rubric changes? Heard something about a shorter loop for mid-level infra?

MeiL: We piloted a streamlined loop: 2 interviews (deep systems + team fit) for mid-level ICs with a 1-week fast-track. Senior roles still get take-home + full loop. We're expanding the pilot to two more teams. Details posted in #eng-hiring.

CarlosD: How are promotions being handled if teams merge? Will people be auto-considered for manager roles?

AnitaP: No auto-promotions. If a merge results in open manager slots, managers will publish a selection process and encourage internal applicants. Promotion decisions follow normal calibration. Compensation changes effective at approval date.

PriyaK: FYI: referral bonus program is unchanged but we'll add a limited-time uplift for critical infra hires (+$5k when referral results in hire by end of Q1). We'll post the form later today.

RajS: Can we get a short comms checklist for managers to announce team merges? Want consistent messaging to ICs.

AnitaP: Yes — we'll publish a 6-point template: purpose + impact, who's impacted, timeline, whether heads are added/removed, support for transitions, and contacts. Template goes to #people-ops and #devex by tomorrow morning.

MeiL: Request for transparency on headcount allocation: could leadership share a simple spreadsheet (team -> approved seats -> status) so managers can plan?

AnitaP: We'll share a read-only headcount tracker next week. It will show approved seats by org, tentative tranche (Q1/Q3), and hiring status (open/working/filled).

CarlosD: If revenue dips and hires are delayed, what's the process for prioritizing which roles move forward?

AnitaP: Prioritization will be based on customer-impact and revenue enablement (SRE/infra that affects SLAs, Dedicated capacity engineers, and sales-facing roles get higher priority). Leadership will publish a prioritization rubric.

RecruitingBot: Note: open reqs and internal candidates should be listed in Greenhouse; mark "internal first" to flag mobility candidates.

AllHandsBot: Recording + slides are at https://redwood/all-hands/2487654321. Action items from the all-hands will be in the follow-up doc.

PriyaK: If anyone has sensitive concerns about role changes, please DM People or me. We'll keep it confidential.

AnitaP: Thanks — appreciate the questions. We'll follow up with the tracker, manager checklist, and referral uplift today/tomorrow.

MeiL: Appreciated. One last note: managers, please pre-clear potential internal moves with People before public announcements to avoid confusion.

RajS: Thanks everyone, will share this with my EMs.

AnitaP: Great, closing the thread in 48h unless there are more Qs.
